fonte: U.S. Congress (26 Stat. 426); U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (Report 1892)
legenda: 1890: three Army engineers to find a site. December 1891: San Pedro.
texto_para_tela: search for a site, 1890 · San Pedro · 1891
nota: A data do relatório é 08/12/1891 na imagem (o OCR lia 5); Willard dá 19/12/1891 como a entrega ao Congresso, e a carta do Chief of Engineers é de 18/12/1891. 'December 1891' cobre todas.
narracao: Now the map has a choice on it: two bays. In 1890, Congress sent three Army engineers to find the best site for a deep-water harbor on this coast. In December 1891, they answered San Pedro, with Mendell on the board.
